assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting
This service directly addresses the symptoms for which the service was rendered
